policy.verification_policy: Nutrition values remain separate from feeding verdicts. verified means the stored record identity (scientific name or Korean standard food name, plant part, raw state) and every stored nutrient value were reconciled against the named official downloadable dataset: USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy JSON 2018-04 / Foundation JSON 2026-04-30) or the RDA Korean standard food composition data. Values are never estimated, averaged across records, or borrowed from a congener, a different plant part, or a non-raw state; unmatched plants are listed in data/nutrition_hold_list_v1.json.
policy.note_ko: 영양성분 수치만으로 육지거북의 급여 안전성·권장 빈도·식단 비율을 판정하지 않는다. 식품 성분값은 품종·재배·분석 조건에 따라 달라질 수 있다.
